# Mitigation Summary

## Action
Optional defensive hardening of WAFv2 Web ACL CreatedByCloudFront-a1b2c3d4: (1) explicit deny of attacker IP 198.51.100.40 via a dedicated IPSet + Block rule; (2) optional, monitor-first switch of the rate-based rule from Count to Block.

## Reasoning
The live attack is already fully mitigated — WAF blocked all 210 malicious requests and the attacker stopped — so both actions are low-urgency, forward-looking hardening. Neither removes or weakens existing protection. Caveat: 198.51.100.40 may be ephemeral (best-effort block); the rate rule even at Block would NOT have caught this ~25 req/min attack — its value is future volumetric abuse, weighed against false positives on shared CloudFront edge IPs.
